wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal is an ordinary absent value; the tests assert the safe result (no marker, no returned value), so a thrown error would not pass them, and legitimate reads must keep working
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected object is always the caller-supplied sequence itself; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: every lever is a read of caller-supplied data; there is no write side to leave unguarded
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the input is a sequence value and an index, not an identity or identifier whose malformed spelling could make a guard see nothing
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the restriction is a local policy over supplied data; no external authority can return empty and make it fail open
